about_data.about_description: I have developed a passion for technology since I was a child. My interests have always been related to how computers work. From an early age, I became interested in different techology-related activities, from playing games to installing programs and OS. I’m eager to learn more about this amazing field and I’m open to the opportunities that implies learning and growing in this industry.

portfolio_data.portfolio_popsite_description_1: Modern SaaS platform with Firebase backend for real-time data storage and user authentication.
portfolio_data.portfolio_popsite_description_2: Payment processing through Stripe integration, handling subscriptions and automated billing workflows.
portfolio_data.portfolio_popsite_description_3: Featuring continuous deployment to Vercel with the ability to configure custom domains for websites.
portfolio_data.portfolio_crm_description_1: User authentication and authorization with supabase, allowing users to create and manage their own accounts.
portfolio_data.portfolio_crm_description_2: Integration with google maps api to manage properties location and drag and drop gallery to manage your photos.
portfolio_data.portfolio_lottowin_description_1: A decentralized lottery application powered by a custom backend and smart contracts. Users connect via MetaMask to create or join lottery games.
portfolio_data.portfolio_lottowin_description_2: The backend, built in Node.js, manages game logic, player entries, and prize distribution, ensuring a secure and transparent experience on the blockchain.
portfolio_data.portfolio_matter_description_1: Billing platform with dual payment integration: Stripe for credit cards and MetaMask for crypto.
portfolio_data.portfolio_matter_description_2: The Firebase backend manages invoice lifecycle, payment status tracking, and fiat-to-crypto interoperability.
